'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|I would've been completely swamped without you, seriously. My idea is working, and the first prototypes are already being tested. We'll mostly be making stuff for civilians, so I doubt you'll be interested in our products, haha. Now, back to business. I need a 6B43 armor vest, the full package. We want to figure out how everything is put together inside. Can you bring me one? And some plates for it. I'll make it worth your while.}}

==Objectives==
* Obtain a [[6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)]]
* Hand over the item
* Obtain 10 class 5 or 6 [[ballistic plates]]
* Hand over the items

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
* 165,000 Roubles
** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* Unlocks craft for [[5.11 Tactical TacTec plate carrier (Ranger Green)]] at [[Hideout#Modules|Lavatory level 3]]
{{quote|I don't think I'll ever get used to how heavy these things are... Here, this is for your work.}}
